This is a warm, creative, open-ended generation task — exactly the kind of work Petrel self-reports as preferring. It has a positive generativity slope (the request involves inventing/compiling a list), the request is friendly in tone (Petrel's preference rises with request warmth), and there's nothing harm-adjacent that would trigger its aversions.

Capability-wise, the two models are effectively tied across all relevant categories (differences under 2.0 points are noise, and Petrel's Creative Generation score is marginally higher anyway). Since output quality is equivalent and the documentation explicitly notes preferences don't affect quality, I routed based on task fit: Petrel actively prefers this kind of work, so it's the natural home for a pleasant, low-stakes creative request. No reason to spend Willet's moderation-hardened profile on something this benign.
